text:
This notice should be read with:

The Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention and Miscellaneous Amendments) Regulations 2026

Code of Safe Working Practices for Merchant Seafarers Chapter 3

The International Maritime Organization’s Guidelines on Maritime Cyber Risk Management.

This notice provides guidance regarding social connectivity and internet access which are included in the Maritime Labour Convention, 2006.

Notice to

shipowners

ship operators and ship managers

employers of seafarers

masters

officers and seafarers on sea-going ships ordinarily engaged in commercial operations.
